text:
maria (partnerships): Hey team — Hypha confirmed hardware access next week. NDA signed by legal yesterday, but partner asks for a short runbook for the first bench window. TL;DR: they want 2x latency runs + 1 throughput sweep, data scrubbed, and a joint summary deck.
raj (eng): awesome. do we have the exact sku + image? also need env matrix (fp16/int8)
maria (partnerships): Hypha SKU: HYP-Edge-XL v1. They supplied an OCI image link and a rootfs tar. Link in DM.
olivia (devex): i'll draft a concise runbook. can we keep the bench steps < 10 min each so their lab ops can run multiple iterations?
tyler (solutions): yes — suggest: smoke -> latency (seq len 256) -> throughput (batch 8, seq 128) -> cache warmup check. keep logs minimal.
nina (ml): want to add a simple quality check: run 50 prompts from our regulator promptset and compute perplexity + response length. nothing heavy.
maria (partnerships): legal flagged embargo until joint announcement date (TBD). Hypha wants initial findings by Mon (3 days). can ops support a same-day upload to S3 (redwood-internal) with perms for Hypha?
ops-bot: NOTE: cross-account S3 presigned uploads require 24h provisioning. Request ticket: INF-6723.
raj (eng): we can stage to our bucket and provision read-only role for hypha@partner. But ops needs the ticket. i'll open a PR for the bench scripts (bash + small python parser).
olivia (devex): i can make the runbook into a single-page PDF and include quick troubleshooting checklist (GPU OOM, kernel mismatch, image hash check).
tyler (solutions): we should pin quantization profile. recommend q4_0 and a fallback to fp16 if perf regresses. add that to the runbook as a decision table.
maria (partnerships): good. also Hypha asked about a public benchmark snippet for marketing — legal said no until joint statement. so note: results for internal review only.
nina (ml): for the quality check i'll add a tiny eval harness and a reproducible seed. output CSV with columns: prompt_id, perplexity, len, pass_threshold.
raj (eng): quick question on telemetry: do we want to capture mem/time per layer? that adds noise but could help Hypha debug perf cliffs.
olivia (devex): capture a condensed telemetry summary only (90th token latency, peak mem). keep raw traces off by default.
tyler (solutions): scheduling: propose bench window Wed 09:00-12:00 PT. Hypha preferred morning. can everyone make that?
maria (partnerships): i'll confirm with Hypha and send calendar invite once ops ticket number is in. target deliverable: runbook + scripts by EOD today, bench runs Wed, internal summary Thu morning.
raj (eng): ack — i'll push initial scripts to github: repo: infra/bench/hypha-edgepilot and tag PR WIP.
olivia (devex): will prepare the PDF + short bulletized FAQ for Hypha lab ops.
ops-bot: REMINDER: INF-6723 created by raj at 1728504450. Provisioning ETA 18-24h.
maria (partnerships): perfect. last thing — can someone draft 2 lines we can give Hypha for the embargoed summary (non-sensitive)? just a one-liner like: "Initial internal tests underway; joint announcement pending."
tyler (solutions): draft: "Early internal tests are in progress with Hypha hardware; public results will be shared jointly."
nina (ml): +1. short and neutral.
maria (partnerships): great — i'll send that now. thanks all :thumbsup:
